variables.description: The host port for the ntfy web interface and API.
variables.label: ntfy Web Port

variables.description: Set the container timezone (e.g., Europe/London, America/New_York).
variables.label: Timezone

variables.description: The base URL for ntfy, used for generating links in notifications. Change 'localhost' to your server's IP address or domain name, and '8077' to the actual host port if different.
variables.label: ntfy Base URL

variables.description: Path to the ntfy cache database file within the container. This should typically point inside the mounted cache volume.
variables.label: ntfy Cache File Path

variables.description: Path to the directory for storing attachment caches within the container. This should typically point inside the mounted cache volume.
variables.label: ntfy Attachment Cache Directory
